notes: Held-out tasks (round 2), written after v0.2's tuning and before any kopt measurement on them; not derived from bench/results/failures.md. Gold read in the code with git grep and sed only. Re-check with `kopt bench bench/tasks-heldout/spring-framework.json --verify`.

tasks.question: When a @Transactional method throws, how does Spring decide between rollback and commit when rollbackFor / noRollbackFor rules are declared?
tasks.search: transaction rollback rules exception commit noRollbackFor rollbackFor decide
tasks.verifiedBy: Read RuleBasedTransactionAttribute.rollbackOn: the shallowest matching RollbackRuleAttribute (getDepth) wins, NoRollbackRuleAttribute means commit, no match falls back to DefaultTransactionAttribute (RuntimeException/Error).

tasks.question: Where does Spring MVC pick the HttpMessageConverter and media type used to write a @ResponseBody return value, from the Accept header and the producible types?
tasks.search: response body message converter accept header producible media type write
tasks.verifiedBy: Read AbstractMessageConverterMethodProcessor: writeWithMessageConverters negotiates acceptable vs producible types (getMostSpecificMediaType) and loops over messageConverters calling canWrite/write.
